messages:
Mara: Quick async standup — kernel / batching / kv warmup update.
Mara: What I did: merged eviction-cap patch to feature/kernel-evict, ran a 6h perf sweep on slot-3 GPU. p50 looks good, but seeing tail ~120ms at p99 for some microbursts.
Dinesh: Nice. Can you paste the bench command so I can replay locally?
Mara: bench command I used: `./bench_run --model llama2-13b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --kv-prefetch=on --runs 100`
Lia: FYI PR #4923 is ready (kernel: prefetch gating + lightweight opt). Tagging @AJ for perf eyes.
AJ: I'll review tonight. Quick note — the p99 spike times line up with microburst queueing I saw earlier; I added traces at `/traces/mara-evict-1812.log`.
Mara: thanks. Also seeing `kv_evictions/sec` spikes when burst > 500 req/s.
Ravi: that sounds like the slot-handoff delayed-ack bug. Pushed a small retry patch on `dedicated/ack-fix` (WIP).
Dinesh: Replayed Mara's command locally — avg token latency 2.1ms, p99 ~115ms, so reproduction looks consistent.
Mara: snippet from the logs for context:
Mara: ```
[2026-03-17T04:12:23Z] kernel: slot=3 queue=14 qlen=512 evict=23 p99=118ms
[2026-03-17T04:20:01Z] bench: kv_warm=true batch=8 tok/s=21000
```
ops-bot: Canary for feature/kernel-evict deployed to slot-3 :rocket:
Lia: quick smoke — canary succeeded, no OOM in 2h window.
Mara: Blocker: need AJ CR + Ravi's retry patch merged before I enable prefetch gating globally.
AJ: on it — will leave comments on #4923 by EOD. I found a small racy free in the slot allocator to fix first.
Ravi: will rebase and add a unit test for the delayed-ack flow.
Dinesh: pinging eng-sre for a quick look at batch slot metrics — @Sasha could you glance at the heatmap when you have a sec?
Sasha: looking now — preliminary indicates slot saturation correlates with eu-west-1 bursts (spikes at 03:00-04:30 UTC).
Mara: good catch. Plan: if SRE confirms region correlated, I'll limit prefetch to non-eu regions first to reduce blast radius.
Lia: can we add a short CI perf job that runs `kv_prefetch=on` with 1000 short-seq requests? would catch regressions faster.
AJ: added a TODO in the PR to gate that test behind nightly CI.
Mara: thanks everyone :thumbsup: — I'll follow up after AJ's CR and Ravi's merge.
Dinesh: minor ask — ping me when you flip the gating and I'll monitor p99 dashboards.
Mara: will do. (reacted :eyes:)
